vv81:1.1: Puṇṇamāse yathā cando nakkhattaparivārito samantā anupariyāti tārakādhipatī sasī. || ||
vv81:2.1: Tathūpamaṃ idaṃ vyamhaṃ dibbaṃ devapuramhi ca atirocati vaṇṇena udayanto va raṃsimā. || ||
vv81:3.1: Veḷuriyasuvaṇṇassa phaḷikārūpiyassa ca masāragallamuttāhi lohiteṅkamaṇīhi ca || ||
vv81:4.1: Citrā manoramā bhūmi veḷuriyassa santhatā kūṭāgārā subhā rammā pāsādo te sumāpito. || ||
vv81:5.1: Rammā ca te pokkharaṇī puthulomanisevitā acchodikā vippasannā soṇṇavālukasanthatā. || ||
vv81:6.1: Nānāpadumasañchannā puṇḍarīkasamotatā surabhiṃ sampavāyanti manuññā māluteritā. || ||
vv81:7.1: Tassā te ubhato passe vanagumbā sumāpitā upetā puppharukkhehi phalarukkhehi cūbhayaṃ. || ||
vv81:8.1: Sovaṇṇapāde pallaṅke muduke goṇasanthate nisinnaṃ devarājaṃ va upatiṭṭhanti accharā. || ||
vv81:9.1: Sabbābharaṇasañchannā nānāmālāvibhūsitā ramenti taṃ mahiddhikaṃ Vasavattīva modasi. || ||
vv81:10.1: Bherisaṅkhamudiṅgāhi vīṇāhi paṇavehi ca ramasi ratisampanno naccagīte suvādite. || ||
vv81:11.1: Dibbā te vividhā rūpā dibbā saddā atho rasā gandhā ca te adhippetā phoṭṭhabbā ca manoramā. || ||
vv81:12.1: Tasmiṃ vimāne pavare devaputta mahappabho atirocasi vaṇṇena udayanto va bhānumā. || ||
vv81:13.1: Dānassa te idaṃ phalaṃ atho sīlassa vā pana atho añjalikammassa taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito
vv81:14.1: ti. || || So devaputto attamano Moggallānena pucchito pañhaṃ puṭṭho viyākāsi yassa kammass' idaṃ phalaṃ. || ||
vv81:15.1: Ahaṃ Kapilavatthusmiṃ Sākiyānaṃ puruttame Suddhodanassa puttassa Kanthako sahajo ahaṃ. || ||
vv81:16.1: Yadā so aḍḍharattāyaṃ bodhāya-m-abhinikkhami so maṃ mudūhi pāṇīhi jālatambanakhehi ca || ||
vv81:17.1: Satthiṃ ākoṭayitvāna, vaha sammā ti c' abravī, ahaṃ lokaṃ tārayissaṃ patto sambodhim uttamaṃ. || ||
vv81:18.1: Tam me giraṃ suṇantassa hāso me vipulo ahu udaggacitto sumano abhisiṃsiṃ tadā ahaṃ. || ||
vv81:19.1: Abhirūḷhañ ca maṃ ñatvā Sakyaputtaṃ mahāyasaṃ udaggacitto mudito vahissaṃ purisuttamaṃ. || ||
vv81:20.1: Paresaṃ vijitaṃ gantvā uggatasmiṃ divākare mamaṃ Channañ ca ohāya anapekkho so apakkami. || ||
vv81:21.1: Tassa tambanakhe pāde jivhāya parilehisaṃ gacchantañ ca mahāvīraṃ rudamāno udikkhisaṃ. || ||
vv81:22.1: Adassanen' ahaṃ tassa Sakyaputtassa sirīmato alatthaṃ garukābādhaṃ khippaṃ me maraṇaṃ ahu. || ||
vv81:23.1: Tass' eva ānubhāvena vimānaṃ āvasām' idaṃ sabbakāmaguṇopetaṃ dibbaṃ devapuramhi ca. || ||
vv81:24.1: Yañ ca me ahuvā hāso saddaṃ sutvāna bodhiyā ten' eva kusalamūlena phusissaṃ āsavakkhayaṃ. || ||
vv81:25.1: Sace hi bhante gaccheyyāsi satthu buddhassa santike mamāpi naṃ vacanena sirasā vajjāsi vandanaṃ. || ||
vv81:26.1: Aham pi daṭṭhuṃ gacchissaṃ jinaṃ appaṭipuggalaṃ dullabhaṃ dassanaṃ hoti lokanāthāna tādinan ti. || ||
vv81:27.1: So kataññū katavedī satthāraṃ upasaṅkami sutvā giraṃ cakkhumato dhammacakkhuṃ visodhayi. || ||
vv81:28.1: Visodhetvā diṭṭhigataṃ vicikicchaṃ vatāni ca vanditvā satthuno pāde tatth' ev' antaradhāyathā ti. || ||
